Card Q&A.a: If there are already any cards stacked under the Tamer, you place the new card at the bottom.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to place a card under a Tamer that already has cards under it, in what order do I place the cards?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Bagra Army] trait from your hand or trash as any of your [Bagra Army] trait Digimon's bottom digivolution cards or under any of your [Bagra Army] trait Tamers.
Inherited Effect: When effects trash this card from a [Bagra Army] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
